rerun_of.note: every repetition is run from scratch; attempt 1 of raw/<id>.r<n>.json has rerun_of = ../../raw/<id>.r<n> (relative to raw/); the first pass is not modified

method.estimator: per metric, the median of the valid repetitions of a cell; latency percentiles are taken per repetition first, then the median; below G8's floor a percentile is reported as "< X ns"; the best throughput repetition is kept as a separate field
method.flags: G4 flags use all valid repetitions: spread_throughput when (max-min)/median > 0.1, spread_p99 when the same ratio of op_latency p99 > 0.25; calib_drift when any repetition drifted more than 0.05. Flags do not decide reruns.
method.rerun_trigger: G4 v2 (trimmed_range_v2): drop the one repetition farthest from the median (only with 3 or more values), then rerun when (max-min)/median of the rest exceeds 0.1 for throughput, or exceeds 0.5 for op_latency p99; the p99 test applies only when the median p99 of all repetitions is at or above G8's floor (4 x clock resolution) and the trimmed p99 range is wider than one clock tick. G5 unchanged: rerun when 2 or more repetitions drifted more than 0.05.
